info.name: Shopizy API — Full E2E Test Suite
info.description:
Complete end-to-end Postman and Bruno test collection for the Shopizy e-commerce API.

## Usage
1. Import this collection into Bruno or Postman and set the `baseUrl` variable (default: `http://localhost:5000`).
2. Run the full collection via Collection Runner in order — each folder automatically seeds variables used by later folders.

## Automated Assertions
Every request contains `pm.test` assertions for status codes, headers, and payload structures. The collection uses `pm.collectionVariables.set` to seamlessly chain dynamic IDs across requests.
